title: SB1869 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 16; Title 39 and Title 40, relative to mental health findings.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-31; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514150906 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB1869.pdf (LegiScan doc 2910220))
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2024-01-31; HB 2872 and SB 1869 share this document. Sections 2-4 repeat section 1's wording for TCA 16-11-206, 16-15-303 and 16-16-120; section 5 does so for the definition in TCA 39-17-1301(1)(B). Section 8 amends TCA 39-17-1316(q). Takes effect July 1, 2024. No amendments in the text read.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 16-10-213(a)(1)(B)): (B) A finding of insanity or that a person is incompetent to stand trial by a court in a criminal proceeding; or
SECTION 6 (TCA 39-17-1307(h)(1)(C)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1307(h)(1)(C), is amended by deleting the subdivision in its entirety.
SECTION 7 (TCA 39-17-1307, new subsection (i)): (1) A person commits an offense who possesses a firearm and has been adjudicated as a mental defective, judicially committed to or hospitalized in a mental institution pursuant to title 33, or had a court appoint a conservator for the person by reason of a mental defect. (2) An offense under subdivision (i)(1) is a Class A misdemeanor.
SECTION 8 (TCA 39-17-1316(q)(4)): (4) It is an offense for a person to knowingly purchase or attempt to purchase a firearm if the person has been judicially committed to a mental institution or adjudicated as a mental defective.
